title: M5 Ultra Phase 3 1K-256K Prefill Acceleration Full Hardware Acceptance Matrix (miv-v0.05-p3-rc1 vs Phase 2 miv-v0.04-p2-rc1)

stage3_promotions: Promoted Hybrid QK-A8 W4A4 (OMLX_M5_W4A4_KEEP_QK_A8 default-ON) after Step 2 precision gate cut 16K Exact PPL 6.96x (37.73 -> 5.42) and Sage2+MInf PPL 1.97x (15.28 -> 7.76) while running +0.4% to +0.8% faster.
Bumped ANE canary calibration key ane_cal_v1 -> ane_cal_v2_p3 so upgrades from pre-Phase-3 kernels never load stale calibration entries.
